content.assessment:
SKILL_MATCH: strong — The candidate has all required skills (Python, SQL, REST APIs) explicitly listed and demonstrates proficiency in Kubernetes and PostgreSQL, which are advanced tools relevant to backend engineering and cloud infrastructure. The cover letter highlights leadership in migrating a monolith to Kubernetes, indicating practical application of Python and REST API skills in scalable systems.  
EXPERIENCE: strong — 3 years of backend experience aligning with the job’s needs, including hands-on work with Python microservices, REST APIs, and Kubernetes. Leadership in a migration project shows deeper technical engagement and problem-solving capabilities.  
SCORE: 95  
RECOMMENDATION: advance  
NOTES: The candidate’s experience with Kubernetes and PostgreSQL strongly supports their backend engineering qualifications, even though "machine learning" is not explicitly mentioned. Their project leadership and focus on scalable systems suggest advanced capabilities beyond basic requirements. The growth trajectory is implied through their experience with modern tools and collaborative mentoring, though no explicit mention of ongoing learning is provided.
